environment: macOS arm64, Apple sips-316, Pillow 13.0.0, libwebp 1.6.0, Firefox 159.0

details.findings: Firefox decoded the registered WebP at a player-accessible journal disclosure in R09. The exact caption and alternative text matched the room binding. The earned activity, R09 notebook and earned R02 Workshop decoration displayed the same asset.

observations.caption: The audit uses one 30 W allowance delivered after losses. The three endpoint demands at that same boundary are 12 W, 11 W and 10 W. Their 33 W total exceeds the allowance by 3 W. Recording this diagnosis changes no equipment.
observations.alt: The shell-shaped ledger has one brass allowance tray on the left and three separate endpoint demand tiles on the right.
